import os
import subprocess
import repo_manager


def _make_local_git_repo(path):
    """Helper: create a local git repo with at least one commit."""
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'init'], cwd=path, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'config', 'user.email', 'test@example.com'], cwd=path, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'config', 'user.name', 'Test User'], cwd=path, capture_output=True)
    with open(os.path.join(path, 'README.md'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('# Upstream Repo\n')
    subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '.'], cwd=path, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', 'initial commit'], cwd=path, capture_output=True)


def test_clone_repo_with_fork_returns_existing_path(tmp_path):
    """If the target repo path already exists, return it without cloning."""
    repo_dir = str(tmp_path / 'repos')
    repo_name = 'existing-repo'
    repo_path = os.path.join(repo_dir, repo_name)
    os.makedirs(repo_path)

    result = repo_manager.clone_repo_with_fork(
        clone_url='http/workspace/example.com/fork.git',
        repo_dir=repo_dir,
        repo_name=repo_name,
        upstream_url='http/workspace/example.com/upstream.git',
    )
    assert result == repo_path


def test_clone_repo_with_fork_clones_from_upstream(tmp_path):
    """Should clone from upstream_url and return the local path with content."""
    upstream_dir = str(tmp_path / 'upstream')
    _make_local_git_repo(upstream_dir)

    repo_dir = str(tmp_path / 'repos')
    repo_name = 'cloned-repo'

    result = repo_manager.clone_repo_with_fork(
        clone_url='http/workspace/example.com/fork.git',
        repo_dir=repo_dir,
        repo_name=repo_name,
        upstream_url=upstream_dir,
    )

    assert result is not None
    assert os.path.isdir(result)
    assert os.path.isfile(os.path.join(result, 'README.md'))


def test_clone_repo_with_fork_sets_up_remotes(tmp_path):
    """After cloning, 'upstream' remote should point to upstream and 'origin' to fork."""
    upstream_dir = str(tmp_path / 'upstream')
    _make_local_git_repo(upstream_dir)

    repo_dir = str(tmp_path / 'repos')
    repo_name = 'cloned-repo'
    fork_url = 'http/workspace/example.com/myfork.git'

    result = repo_manager.clone_repo_with_fork(
        clone_url=fork_url,
        repo_dir=repo_dir,
        repo_name=repo_name,
        upstream_url=upstream_dir,
    )

    assert result is not None

    remotes = subprocess.run(
        ['git', 'remote', '-v'],
        cwd=result, capture_output=True, text=True
    ).stdout

    assert 'upstream' in remotes, 'upstream remote should exist'
    assert 'origin' in remotes, 'origin remote should exist (set to fork)'


def test_get_api_base_still_works():
    """Existing function get_api_base should still work correctly."""
    assert repo_manager.get_api_base('http/workspace/gitcode.com/some/repo') == 'http/workspace/api.gitcode.com/api/v5'
    assert repo_manager.get_api_base('http/workspace/atomgit.com/some/repo') == 'http/workspace/api.atomgit.com/api/v5'


def test_generate_fork_name_still_works():
    """Existing function generate_fork_name should still work correctly."""
    name = repo_manager.generate_fork_name('myrepo')
    assert name.startswith('myrepo-')
    timestamp_part = name[len('myrepo-'):]
    assert len(timestamp_part) == 14
    assert timestamp_part.isdigit()
